title: Krea 2 Turbo, restage a person
description: Puts the person from one photo into a new scene, pose, outfit and light, keeping their likeness, with Krea 2 Turbo and the Krea 2 Identity Edit V2 LoRA in 8 steps: reference boost 2 and the person placed beside the output, so the scene is free, as its model card suggests (aligned keeps the photo's framing). Say how much of the person shows and describe the outfit. The sample photo and the preview were made with Fugue.
